The integrand is the derivative of \(\cos(x)^2\):

\[
\frac{d}{dx}(\cos(x)^2) = 2*\cos(x)*(-\sin(x)) = -2*\sin(x)*\cos(x)
\]

So,

\[
\int -2*\sin(x)*\cos(x)\,dx = \cos(x)^2 + C
\]

<answer>cos(x)**2 + C</answer>
